notes: Targeted web searches for Tokelau with data center/datacenter/server farm/colocation/hyperscale terms found no datacenter facilities or projects, and data center directories such as Data Center Map list no Tokelau locations. Tokelau (population ~1,500 across Atafu, Nukunonu and Fakaofo atolls) has no commercial colocation or hyperscale infrastructure: it is one of the least connected countries in the Pacific, reliant on slow satellite links for international and inter-atoll connectivity (a NZ-funded Southern Cross NEXT cable was planned to improve access), and its electricity supply is small-scale solar PV. Absence is based on negative search evidence.
